reason: Free listing costs me nothing, so I'd maybe let them load my flyers, but I wouldn't pay anything. Instagram already brings my student crowd and I want to see real results before I spend a euro.
objection: An app nobody uses yet. Until I see students actually opening it and coming to my nights because of it, I won't pay, and I don't have much budget at about 34k a year.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app pass the 2,000 monthly users in my city and a few nearby venues showing real numbers of people who came because of it, with the 500-views guarantee actually honoured.
